title: JOR-206 wash-sale scenario matrix
for: OptionsTaxHub PR #280 fix round (one Jordan/Orion-approved round)

round_rules.if_gate_finds_a_keep: Stop. Do not kick another round. Report BLOCKED to Orion.
round_rules.protected: Do not retarget any row marked protected:true, including $924 / NVDA 384 / TSLA 240 / AMD 300 reconcile matches, QQQ IRA $120 Permanent, $50+$50, partly-sold $40, and harvest_checks 4 rows with SOFI $100.

conventions.window: Inclusive 30 days before through 30 days after the sale date (WASH_SALE_WINDOW_DAYS=30). Apr 1 2026 − 30d = Mar 2; Apr 1 + 30d = May 1.
conventions.same_day_same_account: Excluded (b.activity_date != sell.activity_date). Do not change this rule.
conventions.self_lot: Shares this sale (or earlier sales) already closed via FIFO are not a repurchase. Only unconsumed window shares count toward repurchase_quantity and disallowed_loss. Count cumulative used_buy_quantities, not only this sale's closed_now versus the buy's original quantity.
conventions.radar: WashSaleWarning totals wash_sale_flags after dropping a flag only when it matches a same-account hop with not_compared_reason='unallocated'. Do not drop no_1099, matches, differs, or other reconciliation statuses. dashboard/page.tsx passes chains={washSaleChains} and locked={!packetUnlocked}.
conventions.cross_account_not_in_radar: Cross-account estimates are not wash_sale_flags and must not be added to the radar total (same split as $924 vs QQQ $120). They appear in wash_sale_chains with cross_account=true and in cross_account_wash_count.
conventions.ira: ira_traditional and ira_roth are Permanent; the loss does not add to the IRA lot's basis.
conventions.other_taxable: label 'other' (Other/agentic) is deferred; explained_basis includes the disallowed amount.
conventions.values_confirmed_at: staging a4b8441, by running detect_wash_sales / build_cross_account_chains (flags=[] where the self-lot bug would otherwise interfere) and the sample harvest check.

The Individual lot is bought 30 days before it is sold, so a4b8441 treats that closed lot as its own $100 replacement, marks the hop unallocated, and zeroes remaining_loss before the 5 still-open IRA shares can form a $50 Permanent chain. #280 already fixes this exact book; the new round must keep it green.

It does not add to the IRA's basis.

rows.name: Partial close that leaves 5 of the same lot open: not a wash
rows.why_it_matters: Rev. Rul. 56-602: shares from the same purchase that you still hold are not replacement shares for the part you sold. Selling 5 of a 10-share lot at a loss while holding the other 5 is NOT a wash. This matches S03 (the split close never self-replaces). Corrected by Chloe; it supersedes the executor's first draft.
